svg.text: Trailing 100 executions per task · one window ending at each run from 100 onward
Each point summarizes the last 100 runs.
Independent linear y-axes start at zero.
This shows variation within one benchmark.
It does not compare different code versions.
Apple M3 Pro · 2026-09-09 · Compute only · Same saved measurements as the percentile report · No outliers removed
